title: Your tickets

none.heading: Open your order from its email
none.body: This browser tab doesn’t hold an order. Open the link in the email we sent you after your order.

gone.heading: This order can’t be found
gone.body: The link may be wrong. Open it again from the email we sent you.

paid.heading: Your tickets
paid.body: Each person shows their code at the door. We have sent this page’s link to your email address.

awaitingBank.heading: Waiting for your bank
awaitingBank.body: Your tickets are held while the bank confirms the payment. Nothing is issued until it does.

declined.heading: The payment didn’t go through
declined.body: Your bank did not take the payment, so no tickets were issued and nothing was charged.

holdEnded.heading: Your hold has ended
holdEnded.body: The tickets were held for 15 minutes. If your bank took the payment, your tickets will still come to your email address within minutes; if they were sold meanwhile, the money is returned in full.

cancelled.heading: This order was cancelled
cancelled.body: Its tickets are no longer valid.

refunded.heading: This order was refunded
refunded.body: Its tickets are no longer valid, and the payment was returned.

agreements: Each person with an email address receives their own link to agree to the hosts’ statements before the door.

announce.five: Five minutes left on your hold.
announce.one: One minute left on your hold.

ticket.heading: Tickets
ticket.codeLabel: Code to show at the door
ticket.qrHint: Turn your screen’s brightness up when it is scanned at the door.

disagreement.body: The bank and our record of this payment disagree. Please don’t pay again: contact us with the reference below, and we’ll sort it out.
